To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the kNN algorithm can be improved by using the Rocchio approach for training and (ii) combining the improved kNN algorithm with a second kNN algorithm that uses a different set of parameters, results in a more robust event tracking system.

(1) Rocchio and kNN algorithms are effective and robust for text categorization in the context of TDT; (2) kNN variants that consider the number of training documents and the number of relevant documents in each cluster are better than the original kNN method; (3) the combination of kNN variants is better than the original Rocchio method; and (4) the combination of Rocchio and k-Nearest-Neighbor algorithms is the best approach for event tracking.

(1) kNN and Rocchio are among the best-performing methods for event tracking, (2) new variants of kNN and Rochoo improve the performance of these methods significantly, (3) the performance of these algorithms can be further improved by combining them, and (4) the performance of our event trackers is robust over different data sets.
